result.note: A corporate licensing dispute in Kenya with little policy angle for India; one question tests how Tata came to own the Magadi soda ash operation.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, Kenya's President William Ruto ordered Tata Chemicals to exit its natural soda ash operation at Magadi. Through which acquisition had Tata gained this operation?
options: Its 2008 purchase of Jaguar Land Rover
questions.explain: Tata acquired Magadi in 2005 when it bought the British company Brunner Mond, which gave it access to low-cost natural soda ash. The operation dates to 1911. Tata's lease runs to 2053, and the licensing fight remains in court.
questions.source: Tata acquired Magadi through its 2005 purchase of Britain’s Brunner Mond, gaining low-cost natural soda ash.
